input.quote: 13.5 SFJ Representation, Warranty and Covenant. SFJ hereby represents, warrants and covenants that it will have, as and when needed, sufficient funds to satisfy its obligations hereunder.
input.rationale: SFJ performs the SFJ Services (global CRO oversight and execution of Clinical Trials in the SFJ Territory), but the only SFJ warranty in Article 13 is the funding covenant in Section 13.5; the mutual reps (13.1.1-13.1.2) are authority/no-conflict only, and the balance of Article 13 is PB-side. Section 2.2.2 imposes a bare compliance covenant with no warranty duration or remedy. Section 13.6.2 then disclaims every warranty not set out in Article 13, so PB has no conformance warranty and no repair, replacement or refund remedy - a failure of the fallback on all four elements. We insert the shortest fallback-level SFJ warranty inside Article 13 (so it survives the 13.6.2 carve-out): 90-day software conformance to documentation, 30-day SFJ Services warranty, with repair/replacement or refund. No amendment to the disclaimer is needed because 13.6.2 excepts anything set forth in Article 13.

proposal.summary: Insert a short SFJ performance warranty (90-day software conformance, 30-day SFJ Services) with repair/replace or refund remedies inside Article 13.
proposal.comment: [Playbook] Article 13 contains no SFJ performance warranty and Section 13.6.2 disclaims everything not set out in Article 13, leaving PB without any conformance warranty or remedy. We add a short fallback-level warranty inside Article 13 (90 days for any software, 30 days for the SFJ Services) with repair, replacement or refund as the remedy.

ops.text: SFJ warrants that any software delivered by SFJ hereunder will conform in all material respects to its documentation for ninety (90) days following delivery and that the SFJ Services will conform to the requirements of this Agreement for thirty (30) days following performance. For any breach of this warranty, SFJ will repair or replace the non-conforming software or SFJ Services or refund the amounts paid for them.

mappings.element: Software is warranted to conform to its documentation for at least 90 days.
Services are warranted for at least 30 days.
Warranty remedies include repair or replacement.
